evidence: Swap test fails: a council parking-permit form or a GP appointment booker could reuse the frame unchanged (white header bar with icon + wordmark, pale grey-blue ground, single left column of 320px native inputs, dark-teal rectangular primary button, red-bordered 'There is a problem' summary, key/value summary list, white footer with phone number). Only the copy (sill gate, HW, pontoon, draught) and the small anchor glyph are bound to the harbour; with the name and copy hidden a reader could not tell it is for boats.

Category-guess test fails: predicted default for a small public-facing booking service is exactly this public-service form pattern (one column, native controls, bordered error summary, summary list). Nothing in the identity-carrying elements departs from it.

Similar-prompt test fails: a brief for 'campsite pitch booking for a small coastal site' would land on the same frame, the same radio cards ('Pitch A, up to 8 metres, £x per night') and the same tide-agnostic table styling.

The one product-bound device, the tide-times table on / (root/default/1280-light.png, y 697-1036), is rendered as a default data table with headers misaligned to right-aligned figures; it is not treated as a signature and the sill-gate window is only a grey caption beneath it.
Berth cards on /berths.html say 'Afloat at every state of the tide' / 'Settles on soft mud' in grey body text; no visual encoding of tide, depth or gate anywhere in the journey.

unfinished: browser-default date input showing 'yyyy/mm/dd' and native select chevrons on / at every width
identity is only an anchor icon and the name in bold body-size text in the header
no focal point beyond the H1 on any screen; nothing on the page rewards a look
Harbour rules section is only a heading and a bulleted list
footer band stops short and leaves an empty grey band below it on short pages (boat-html default 1280, review default 1280, confirmed default 1280, booking-stopped 375)
half-empty right column at 1024-1440: content runs in a ~540px left column with the right half of the page blank on every route
the '...' menu button on /berths.html floats alone at the far right in an otherwise empty band, detached from the content column
reference 'BK-' / '409' broken across lines on the booking-stopped screen at 375
tide-table column headers 'Morning'/'Afternoon' left-aligned over right-aligned figures
evidence: root/default/1280-light.png and 375-light.png: clean, orderly, legible but a default form plus a plain table; the brief's tide concept appears only in words
confirmed-html.../default/1280-light.png: 'Booking confirmed' heading, three key/value rows and a link, then a white footer floating above ~420px of empty ground
boat-html.../length-over-limit/375-light.png: two lines of text then empty screen
Typography (a humanist sans, bold headings) and the dark-teal accent are tidy and consistent, so it is not unappealing, but nothing would make a skipper call it attractive or cared-for beyond tidy
